names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Grigorie Sinaitul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Γρηγόριος ο Σιναΐτης», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: saint.gr's heading for him on the 11 Φεβρουαρίου page, «Οσιος Γρηγοριος ο Σιναϊτης (1255 - 1347)». doxologia.ro, cited on this folder's Romanian row, gave no year of birth.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «sfântul Grigorie a trecut la Domnul pe 27 noiembrie 1346 și este prăznuit pe 6 aprilie.» saint.gr's heading on its 11 Φεβρουαρίου page gives «(1255 - 1347)» and argues for neither year; the attested day and year are kept and the disagreement is recorded rather than averaged into an interval.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: The life page says he died on 27 November 1346 and is kept on 6 April: «Sfântul Grigorie a trecut la Domnul pe 27 noiembrie 1346 și este prăznuit pe 6 aprilie.» The day of death and the day of commemoration are different, and 6 aprilie is the day the calendar prints him on.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Grigorie Sinaitul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Γρηγόριος ο Σιναΐτης»

attestations.note: The page saint.gr serves on this day is a stub: it heads him «Οσιος Γρηγοριος ο Σιναϊτης (1255 - 1347)», declares the feast fixed on 11 Φεβρουαρίου, and for the life sends the reader elsewhere — «Βλέπε βιογραφικό του σημείωμα στις 6 Απριλίου». 6 April is the day this folder's Romanian row already keeps him on, off doxologia.ro. This row records the Greek day page read; whether saint.gr's 6 April is a second Greek commemoration or only where it files the life has not been established here, and no second row is made for it.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
